The '''dirigible squire''' is a character who appears in the second episode of the second season of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].

==Background==
This [[Squire (TV series)|squire]] is a member of the [[Knights of San Fernando]] in 2296, and was part of the force stationed on the ''[[Caswennan]]'' during the chapter's move to claim [[Area 51]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Golden Rule]]===
After [[Maximus]] returns to the ''Caswennan'' from his mission to a [[shadowy facility]], he hands over the [[control panel]] he obtained from the facility to [[Quintus|Elder Cleric Quintus]]; the squire is seen standing by at a nearby console. Quintus then hands the control panel to the squire, who brings it to the console and plugs it in.

The squire then sends light signals to two Brotherhood scribes on the ground, signaling them to activate the machine that will uncover Area 51, and watches as the sand dunes blanketing Area 51 are blown away by the wind turbines.

==Appearances==
The dirigible squire appears only {{In|FOTV}}.
{{FOTV appearances|10=202}}

==Behind the scenes==
While this character is credited as a squire in "[[The Golden Rule]]," they are instead referred to as a scribe in the episode's audio description. The audio description is likely incorrect, as the character is wearing a squire's uniform.
